select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.CCY ccy, T2.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, T2.BUSI_PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.PRICE*100 price, T2.VDATE vdateAdd, T2.MDATE mdateAdd, T2.TERM_DAYS termDays, T1.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T3.TRADER trader, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.MIN_AMT minAmt, T1.REMARK remark from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T3 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T3.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
